codex.preamble:
> **Host adaptation (Codex):** This skill is projected from the canonical Claude Code source. Apply these host equivalences while preserving every workflow invariant, check, and approval gate:
> - **Tools:** Claude `Read` -> Codex file reading; `Edit`/`Write` -> Codex file editing/patching; `Grep`/`Glob` -> `rg`/file search; `Bash` -> shell command execution.
> - **Subagents:** Claude `Agent` (`subagent_type: "<role>"`) -> Codex native agent `<role>` (`scout`, `implementer`, `reviewer`, `verifier`, `architect_escalation`) defined in `~/.codex/agents/<role>.toml`. For `isolation: worktree`, use an isolated `git worktree`.
> - **MCP (Azure DevOps):** `azure-devops:<tool>` -> invoke the matching tool exposed by the `azure-devops` MCP server configured in `~/.codex/config.toml`.
> - **Project governance & permissions:** Repository `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, and `.claude/settings.json` remain authoritative project sources and deny boundaries; read and obey them in Codex exactly as in Claude.
> - **Shared state & metrics:** Keep `%USERPROFILE%\.claude\brixbroker\` (`rodadas.csv`, `execute-rodadas.csv`) and `%TEMP%\claude-handoffs\Broker\` unchanged so runs, handoffs, and audits interoperate across Claude, Codex, and Antigravity.
